svg.aria-label: Architecture overview of Web Agentic Memory: agents recall verified workflows by URL and keywords (read path), and contributions flow through a queue, a model-driven curator and server-side rules into a layered memory catalog (write path).
svg.title: Architecture overview of Web Agentic Memory: agents recall verified workflows by URL and keywords (read path), and contributions flow through a queue, a model-driven curator and server-side rules into a layered memory catalog (write path).
svg.text: Shared, verified workflow memory that browser agents recall by URL + keywords
no model in the read path
exact duplicates by rule, no model call
one LlmProvider interface · chosen by configuration
every change is a new immutable
